items.summaryZh: 巴西大奖赛中，F1车队通常会在FP1中派遣年轻车手，2026年的赛事也不例外。包括哈斯的新人拉斐尔·卡马拉在内的七位年轻车手在伊塔乌托博斯周末的练习赛中亮相。以下是所有练习赛的时间。
items.originalTitle: F1 2026 Brazilian Grand Prix practice results
detailZh: 巴西大奖赛是那些一级方程式车队通常喜欢在FP1中部署'新手'车手的赛事之一，2026年的赛事也不例外。
在伊纳戈斯周末的开始，有七位这样的车手进行了替补出场，包括哈斯的新人拉斐尔·卡马拉，他将在本周末的家乡赛事中首次亮相大奖赛。
13 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+1.300秒
14 阿维德·林德布拉德（小红牛）+1.321秒
detailEn: The Brazilian Grand Prix is one of those races where Formula 1 teams typically like to deploy 'rookie' drivers in FP1 - and the 2026 edition was no exception.
Seven such drivers made stand-in appearances at the start of the Interlagos weekend, including Haas newcomer Rafael Camara - who'll make his grand prix debut at his home race this weekend.
keyPointsZh: 拉斐尔·卡马拉将在本周末的比赛中首次亮相大奖赛
keyPointsEn: Rafael Camara will make his grand prix debut at his home race this weekend

items.titleZh: 赫塔获得FP1超级驾照积分，可申请超级驾照 #F1 #巴西大奖赛
items.summaryZh: 赫塔完成100公里FP1赛事，获得积分，可申请超级驾照；凯迪拉克确认赫塔将在Interlagos进行另一场FP1赛事，以获得最后的超级驾照积分。
items.originalTitle: Herta’s hit the magic 100km for an FP1 Super Licence point, so he’s able to apply for that licence now #F1 #BrazilGP
items.summaryEn:
Herta’s hit the magic 100km for an FP1 Super Licence point, so he’s able to apply for that licence now #F1 #BrazilGPChris Medland: Confirmation from Cadillac of another FP1 outing for Colton Herta at Interlagos, as he goes in search of that final Super Licence point
A clean FP1 with enough running will allow him to apply for a Super Licence, and could see him replace Valtteri Bottas next season #F1
detailZh:
赫塔完成100公里FP1赛事获得积分，因此他现在可以申请超级驾照 #F1 #巴西大奖赛Chris Medland：凯迪拉克确认，科顿·赫塔将在Interlagos进行另一场FP1赛事，以获得最后的超级驾照积分。
一场干净的FP1赛事，只要跑足足够的里程，将允许他申请超级驾照，并可能使他下赛季取代瓦尔特里·博塔斯 #F1
detailEn:
Herta’s hit the magic 100km for an FP1 Super Licence point, so he’s able to apply for that licence now #F1 #BrazilGPChris Medland: Confirmation from Cadillac of another FP1 outing for Colton Herta at Interlagos, as he goes in search of that final Super Licence point
A clean FP1 with enough running will allow him to apply for a Super Licence, and could see him replace Valtteri Bottas next season #F1
